Convert MIRD pain drawings to a pdr_list

Source: R/pdr_mird2pdr.R
pdr_mird2pdr.Rd

MIRD exports pain drawings in a custom format like: (,1,2,5,4,),(,8,8,7,7,) which corresponds to:

Usage

pdr_mird2pdr(
  mird_pd,
  id = seq_along(mird_pd),
  file = "",
  version = "",
  width = as.integer(450),
  height = as.integer(500),
  units = "px",
  timestamp = "",
  app = "",
  tool = "pen",
  draw_input_type = "mouse",
  tool_width = as.integer(1),
  point_density = as.integer(1),
  spray_radius = as.integer(1),
  alpha = as.numeric(1),
  color = "#ff0000",
  flipy = TRUE
)

Arguments

mird_pd

A character vector of MIRD pain drawings.

id

A unique id for each drawing (default: seq_along(mird_pd)).

file

File name (default "").

version

Version (default "").

width

Canvas width, integer (default 450L).

height

Canvas height, integer (default 500L).

units

Units (default "px").

timestamp

Timestamp (default "").

app

App name (default "").

tool

Drawing tool (default "pen").

draw_input_type

Input type (default "mouse").

tool_width

Tool width, integer (default 1L).

point_density

Point density, integer (default 1L).

spray_radius

Spray radius, integer (default 1L).

alpha

Alpha, numeric between 0 and 1 (default 1.0).

color

Stroke colour (default "#ff0000").

flipy

Logical (default TRUE). If TRUE, the y-axis is flipped (via pdr_modify_points() with op = "flipy"), because MIRD has its origin in the upper left corner whereas paindrawr uses the lower left.

Value

A pdr_list (see pdr_match()) of length length(mird_pd).

Details

xyindex
121
541
882
772

This function takes a vector of length n of such MIRD strings and converts it into a pdr_list of length n (see pdr_match() for the terminology). Strings that are NA give an NA element (NA in, NA out); strings too short to hold a point give a pdr_drawing without points and strokes.

The intended use case is a data frame (tibble) of MIRD data including pain drawing data. A new pdr_list column can be generated with a simple dplyr::mutate() call.

Each of the parameters supplied (except mird_pd) must be either of the same length as mird_pd or of length 1, in which case it is repeated.

Examples

mird <- c(
  "(,460,709,463,709,464,719,448,720,449,712,)",
  "(,393,682,430,672,429,682,)",
  NA
)
pdr_list <- pdr_mird2pdr(mird, id = c("a", "b", "c"))
pdr_list[[1]]$.points
#> # A tibble: 5 × 3
#>      .x    .y .index
#>   <int> <int>  <int>
#> 1   460  -209      1
#> 2   463  -209      1
#> 3   464  -219      1
#> 4   448  -220      1
#> 5   449  -212      1

# Typical use: create a pdr_list column in a tibble
tibble::tibble(id = c("a", "b", "c"), mird = mird) |>
  dplyr::mutate(pdr_data = pdr_mird2pdr(mird, id = id))
#> # A tibble: 3 × 3
#>   id    mird                                        pdr_data         
#>   <chr> <chr>                                       <list>           
#> 1 a     (,460,709,463,709,464,719,448,720,449,712,) <named list [10]>
#> 2 b     (,393,682,430,672,429,682,)                 <named list [10]>
#> 3 c     NA                                          <lgl [1]>
